meta.source: home-assistant_v2.db (recorder, read immutable) — NOT a CSV export
meta.note:
States only, no attributes — same limitation as the CSV path. Entities whose state never changed inside the window are carried in `initial` rather than being absent, which the CSV path could not do.
GROUND TRUTH measured off this series: cleaning_area is quantised to exactly 1 m² (sensor exposes ft²: 10.7639104167097 ft² = 1.000000 m²), cleaning_time advances in 0.5-minute steps every 30 s. Kitchen swept 0->2 m² in 120 s; phase2 swept 0->6 m² in 390 s (counters reset per phase). The RECORD claims 90 s/1 m², 0 s/0 m², 270 s/4 m² — 150 s and 3 m² of real cleaning are missing.
